resolved_findings.finding: A new UITest file was absent from the generated Xcode project, producing a misleading zero-test success.
resolved_findings.correction: Regenerate the project and require exactly one discovered, non-skipped journey.

resolved_findings.finding: The UI runner read a build setting only from process environment and skipped its configured disposable backend.
resolved_findings.correction: Read the UITest bundle value with environment fallback, matching the repository fixture convention.

resolved_findings.finding: Bit-exact Date equality rejected a valid Keychain journal after JSON numeric round-trip.
resolved_findings.correction: Keep byte readback in the persistence layer and compare the full decoded record at service-contract millisecond precision.

resolved_findings.finding: The Lab sheet could obscure the persistent isolation banner after a successful entry.
resolved_findings.correction: Close the presenting Product Lab only after verified child adoption and empty-state readback.
